scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:diffs && npm run lint:age && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:js: biome lint --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn static/*.js desktop/frontend desktop/*.mjs desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs tests && node desktop/check-js.mjs && prettier --check "static/*.js" "desktop/frontend/*.js" "desktop/*.mjs" "desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs" "tests/*.cjs" "tests/helpers/*.cjs"
scripts.format:js: biome lint --write static/*.js desktop/frontend desktop/*.mjs desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs tests ; prettier --write "static/*.js" "desktop/frontend/*.js" "desktop/*.mjs" "desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs" "tests/*.cjs" "tests/helpers/*.cjs"
scripts.lint:css: biome lint --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn static/*.css && node desktop/check-css.mjs && prettier --check "static/*.css"
scripts.check:diffs: cd desktop/diffs-build && npm ci && node check.mjs
scripts.lint:rust: cd desktop && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets
